title: evidence
description: One receipt for one state claim (COMP-DOGFOOD-EVIDENCE-GATE-1, row A of COMP-DOGFOOD-1). The caller says what it saw; the Compose server re-checks it against the machine (git, ps, the file, the screenshot) and never trusts it. An accepted receipt is stored and returned as an `ev:<id>` (`#/definitions/evidenceRef`), which a later claim may cite in place of the object (the ops ledger, the message bus and the four state tools all take the ref; lib/evidence-cli.js mints one outside MCP). The validator is lib/evidence.js `validateEvidence`; the re-checks are lib/evidence.js `verifyEvidence`; the store is lib/evidence.js `evidenceStorePath` (one JSON line per accepted receipt, `#/definitions/record`).
_source: smart-memory-ops units/COMP-DOGFOOD-1/plan-dag.md row A (OWNER GO, shape (a): Compose is the system of record)

evidenceRef.description: The id the server returns for an accepted receipt. `ev:` then 16 lower-case hex characters. Citing it re-uses the stored, already re-checked receipt under the SAME id: its kind must back the claim (contracts/evidence-words.json, EVIDENCE_WRONG_KIND), its subject must match (EVIDENCE_SUBJECT_MISMATCH), a RUNNING cite is re-verified and must be checked within 15 min (EVIDENCE_STALE). An id the store does not hold as a valid record is refused (EVIDENCE_UNKNOWN_REF).

evidence.description: One receipt. `kind` picks the shape; every kind carries the claimed time `at` and the claiming session `by`.

at.description: When the caller says it observed the thing (ISO 8601 with offset). For `process` the server compares the check time against `launched_at`, not `at`.

by.description: The claiming session or runner name (`s2-coord`, `codex-review-3`).

absPath.description: An absolute path on the Compose host.

claimedLine.description: A line the caller says the file holds. Matched as a substring of one line (no regex), so a pasted line need not carry its line-end or leading stamp.

sha.description: A commit is on the repo's default branch. Re-check: `git rev-parse --verify --quiet <sha>^{commit}` in `repo` (server/lifecycle-guard.js gitCommitExists), then `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> <branch>` for the default branch (origin/HEAD, else main, else master; local or origin/). An optional `branch` names a declared land branch instead (`land_branches` in contracts/evidence-words.json, starting at 2.0): the same ancestor check against that branch; any other name is refused; naming the default branch is the same as naming none.

process.description: A launched job is still running. Re-check: refused as too early before `launched_at` + 120 s; then the pid must be alive (`ps -p`), its command (`ps -o command=`) must contain `label`, and when `exit_file` or `log` is named, an exit code there (77 is the seat-ceiling gate) or a gate line in the log fails the claim with that line quoted.

file.description: A file was written. Re-check: `at` is at most 15 min before the server's check and not in the future, the file exists, its mtime is no older than `at` minus the server's skew, and `line` (when given) is in it.

log.description: A log says something. Same re-check as `file`; `line` is required, a log receipt is always a claim about a line.

screenshot.description: A screenshot was taken. Re-check: the PNG exists, is fresh (as `file`), and `region` (when given) lies inside the image.

command.description: A command printed a line. The server never re-runs the command: `output_line` must appear in `log`, the file the caller wrote the output to, which must be fresh (as `file`).

pixel.description: A point on screen shows a colour. Re-check: the PNG is sampled at `point` and compared channel by channel with `expected` within the server's tolerance (lib/evidence.js PIXEL_TOLERANCE).

subject.description: What the receipt was accepted for. The four state tools fill it (the tool and the claim it backed: feature code and the claimed state, or gate id and outcome); record_evidence and `evidence-cli.js record --subject` take it from the caller (`unit` or `feature`, and `claim`). Absent for a receipt recorded with no subject. A cite through a state tool must name the same feature (or unit, or gate) as the record's subject (EVIDENCE_SUBJECT_MISMATCH); a record with no subject is cited only by its own `by` session (COMPOSE_SESSION_NAME).

unit.description: An ops unit code (record_evidence); compared with a cite's feature code like `feature`.

claim.description: The state the receipt backs: a feature status (`COMPLETE`), a state word (`RUNNING`, `LANDED`), or `evidence-only` for a record_completion with set_status false.

record.description: One line of the evidence store: an accepted receipt, its id, when the server checked it, and what each check found. Every reader (lib/evidence.js readEvidence, claim_check.py) validates a line against this definition; a line that fails is unknown. A cite of an existing id never adds a line here: it appends `{cites, at, tool, subject, by}` to the side log beside the store (`evidence-cites.jsonl`, lib/evidence.js citesPath), and the id stays the same.
